# Descriptions
@@ 1
Causes an object of up to 1 pound mass to vibrate rapidly; if fragile it may
break (roll a RR). If it is an object held by a being the being must make a RR
or fumble it (each round).
@@ 2
Exerts 1 pound of pressure on a person or object. Object cannot be moved by
staying alone, and pressure can only be in one direction.
@@ 3
Can move one object, up to 1 pound in mass, up to 1' per second (with no
acceleration). If the caster stops concentration before the duration is up,
the object remains stationary as if it had a Staying spell of an equal weight
limit cast upon it.
@@ 4
As Vibrations I, except mass limit is 5 pounds.
@@ 5
As Staying I, except mass limit is 5 pounds.
@@ 6
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 5 pounds.
@@ 7
As Vibrations I, except mass limit is 25 pounds.
@@ 8
As Staying I, except mass limit is 25 pounds.
@@ 9
As Vibrations I, except mass limit is 50 pounds.
@@ 10
By concentrating on the mind of a missile firer (the firer cannot be the
caster) and the flight of the missile, the caster causes +50 to be added to
the attack roll of the missile. The caster must concentrate, touch the firer
and see the missile for the entire round that the missile is fired.
@@ 11
As Telekinesis I, except the mass limit is 25 pounds.
@@ 12
As Staying I, except the mass limit is 50 pounds.
@@ 13
As Vibrations I, except as many objects (up to 5 pounds each) as the caster’s
level can be vibrated (they must all be within the field of vision of the
caster).
@@ 14
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 50 pounds.
@@ 15
As Staying I, except mass limit is 100 pounds.
@@ 16
Caster may “hurl” one object (that starts within 10' of him) of 1 pound or
less with sufficient force to deliver an attack. Attacks are resolved on the
Sling Attack Table with a maximum range of 300'. The OB of the attack is the
caster’s directed spell skill with this spell. If Arms Law is not available,
use the Shock Bolt Attack Table (with a maximum range of 300') delivering
Impact criticals.
@@ 17
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 100 pounds.
@@ 19
As Mass Vibrations, except objects may be up to 25 pounds in mass.
@@ 20
As Aiming, except missile attack bonus is 100.
@@ 25
As Staying I, except mass limit is 10 pounds per level.
@@ 30
As Telekinesis I, except mass limit is 10 pounds per level.
@@ 50
As Aiming, except missile attack automatically does maximum damage. If the
target is a Large or Super Large creature, the attack is treated as a Slaying
attack.
